options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild - a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle - restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the 14 N20-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the BMW N20 engine?
faqLeft.a: The N20 is BMW's turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, in production since 2015. It's fitted across 14 different BMW models, from the 2 Series up to the X7, XM and Z4.

faqLeft.q: Which BMW models use the N20?
faqLeft.a: 2 Series, 3 Series, 4 Series, 5 Series, 6 Series, 7 Series, 8 Series, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, XM and Z4 - see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the N20 differ between BMW models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, mounting, and hybrid-system integration differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is a N20 from one BMW model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. A N20 from a 2 Series isn't a drop-in match for a N20 from an X7 - ancillaries, mounting, and hybrid-system integration all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a BMW N20 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on N20 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you work on N20 hybrid applications?
faqRight.a: Yes. N20 MHEV and PHEV applications (550e, X5 xDrive50e, X6 xDrive50e, X7 xDrive50e, XM 50e) are within our workshop capability, with the relevant hybrid-system ancillaries accounted for once your exact model is confirmed.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used BMW N20 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my BMW if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a N20 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most N20 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
